title: Edmund and the Crown
author: Hazel Amberdale
blurb: Yara Sterling, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
